title: Characteristic drift following a production location transfer
engineering_question: A component characteristic has drifted out of specification after a sourcing change. What failed in the transfer, and what must the supplier demonstrate before release?
one_liner: Assess the supplier quality risk associated with this failure pattern.
initial_input: Incoming inspection identified a batch of suspension bushings with radial stiffness below the lower specification limit, following a production location transfer.
expected_impacted_domains: Supplier process capability and transfer governance
expected_reasoning_paths: RC-004 identifies an under-cure cause, and the systemic finding is that the transfer checklist did not require cure profile requalification
TR-015 shows a separate press-fit capability problem, so there are two independent process concerns from one transfer
TR-016 durability pass was achieved on incumbent-source parts, so the durability evidence does not cover the transferred source
QI-005 field knock noise is a plausible downstream consequence of FM-072 bushing displacement
known_unknowns: RC-004 is not confirmed - the cure profile record from the transferred location is not in the environment
Quantity of affected parts already fitted to vehicles is not represented
No stiffness measurement exists on parts recovered from field vehicles
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data
